title: An imported invoice never appears in the Customer Invoice report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play".
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Import a file made for this test, file A, from the downloaded Invoices import template (Settings, then Invoices under Data Import), with one Labor row dated today: a new invoice number (invoice B), an existing customer, *Line Title "Replace tie rod" and Line Description "excessive play", so invoice B exists only as an imported invoice.
  • Write down the numbers of invoice A and invoice B.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
  5. Search the sheet for invoice A's number with Find (Ctrl+F, or Cmd+F on a Mac).
  6. Search the sheet for invoice B's number with Find.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • The file opens in Google Sheets.

Step 5:

  • Invoice A's row is found: today's invoices made in ShopView are in the file.
  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play".

Step 6:

  • No cell holds invoice B's number: the imported invoice is not in the report, although it is dated today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R12: “An imported historical invoice never reaches the live QuickBooks sync, so its line text is unaffected whatever the import wrote into it. It never appears in the downloadable Customer Invoice report either, which lists invoices created in ShopView only.”
  • Story 3, Prerequisites: “An invoice's line text is being produced, either by the live QuickBooks sync or by the downloadable Customer Invoice report.”

From: Product's answers to our questions 9-14 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, saved in po-answers-2026-10-27/), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Answer 12: “12. (a) No. The report only lists invoices created in ShopView, and imported invoices are stored separately, so they never appear in it (S3-R12). (b) and (c) don't apply. The design board's example is illustrative; the page wins.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
